text: The paper reports that the increase in evaluation error is not driven by a few susceptible subjects: 71%, 76% and 90% of evaluators' error rates increase after optimizing the task-specific QA, general QA and programming rewards respectively, with paired t-test p-values of 0.003, 0.003 and 0.049.
title: Most individual evaluators' error rates rise after RLHF (paired t-tests)
